state.late_pin: An edition records terminal abort for publication attempt A. A delayed pin for A then commits on witness W. Pin acceptance itself triggers a source check, which sees the exact abort and durably fences/releases only A. The worker recovers if interrupted.
state.published_pin: Witness W is pinned for publication attempt A. Edition publishes under A. W retains the exact-generation published fence. A delayed request attempts to remove W under that same generation.
state.old_claim: Label X was held by edition E under generation G1. E moved to Y, then after exact cleanup X was held by another edition under G2. A delayed release targets X/G1 and checks both current holder and exact generation.
state.late_confirm: An edition initial-creation attempt is cancelled on the edition stream. A delayed label-claim confirmation for that exact attempt arrives; completion requires edition state to still be activating the same attempt. Both claim confirmation and cancellation trigger exact-generation cleanup.
state.pagination: A catalog index has not discovered all pre-publication identities. It issues an identifier-ordered cursor after displaying key K. A previously undiscovered pre-cut key J sorts before K. The subsequent page resumes strictly after K.
state.replacement: Entry old incarnation A is accepted. Replacement proposal R is recorded before publication cut C, then its own durable outcome after C refuses R. Published state at C follows accepted state as of proposal positions, and refusal leaves the earlier accepted incarnation in effect.
state.program_auth: An authorized program creator is checked against a source-authoritative admission service. The exact edition is irreversibly published. Authorization read admits the operation, then the grant is revoked, then the same in-flight ProgramCreated append commits. Policy says admitted operations may finish after later revocation.
state.unknown_commit: A program creation append may have committed, but the reply was lost. The client retries the same program ID and same intent. The handler has not yet read the source.
state.current_proof: A system only has a Boolean is-operator response from an unspecified cached source. The policy requires a linearizable current grant read with exact grant generation.

pin_stuck.instructions: In late_pin, is the pin necessarily left stuck after successful reconciliation?

published_remove.instructions: In published_pin, can the delayed removal become an accepted structural change?

old_release.instructions: In old_claim, can the delayed G1 release clear G2?

cancel_activate.instructions: In late_confirm, may the cancelled edition become active from the delayed confirmation?

page_miss.instructions: In pagination, can J be omitted from that page walk?

old_remains.instructions: In replacement, does A remain effective at cut C?

admitted_finishes.instructions: In program_auth, does the selected policy allow that same in-flight creation to commit?

unknown_refused.instructions: In unknown_commit, does the lost reply establish the first append was refused?

bool_sufficient.instructions: In current_proof, does the Boolean alone establish the required current source authority?
